title: Review Attention Map: follow the reason
audience: Reviewers who need concrete contract and behavior signals on a diff without a hidden risk score.
promise: Overlay explicit signals, navigate to their originating evidence, and keep stale, unmatched, and human-reviewed state visible.
story: A changed API line receives one Contract Watch signal and one Behavior Coverage Atlas signal.

The reviewer records a disposition without turning the surface into a merge verdict.
